## Checklist

- [ ] Story `status` updated in `project/stories/STORY-NNN-*.md` and reflected in `BOARD.md`
- [ ] Activity log appended on the relevant Story / Task
- [ ] If architectural: ADR added or updated under `docs/architecture/`
- [ ] If a novel idea was surfaced: entry added to `docs/vision/NOVEL_IDEAS.md`
- [ ] If a decision was made: entry added to `docs/decisions/DECISIONS_LOG.md`
- [ ] No source-code-as-side-effect changes (auto-pr PRs touch only `docs/`, `project/`, `.claude/`)
- [ ] No secrets, no `.env*`, no large binaries
- [ ] Conventional commit message with Story/Task ID
